_meanings:
.²1 The sixth day of a lunar fortnight.
.²2 The sixth or genitive case (in <ab>gram.</ab>).
.²3 An epithet of Durgā in the form of Kātyāyanī, one of the 16 divine mothers.
.²4 A goddess worshipped on the sixth day of child-birth (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>{#sawavAI#}</ns>);
 {#gaReSaM janmadAM zazWIM devIM jIvantikAmapi#} <ls>Śiva B. 6. 48</ls>.

the genitive Tatpuruṣa compound, one in which, when
 dissolved, the first member usually stands in the genitive case.

worship of the goddess {#zazWI#} performed on
 the sixth day after a womanʼs delivery.
